(3) On a Hub-image 3-node cluster that passes the deployer's readiness predicate (/health ready:true means only that a SQL engine object exists), CREATE TABLE answers contractState pending / schema_replica_convergence_pending; replicas become active Raft services on nodes 1 and 3 at 19:52:53Z, yet the serve lane stays blocked (PRIORITY_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY_PENDING, then planning_snapshot_refresh_pending / config_safe_mode; provisioning restarts with required=2 provisionable=0/1; rebalancer topology_settling_blocked node_ready_lease_incomplete for all three nodes; learner_address_unresolvable on node 3; replica_operations-p1 participant write timeouts); every Scenario A UPDATE on every node answers after ~29.8 s with DISTRIBUTED_PARTICIPANT_FAILURE Partition service not found; the table never became routable in 13 minutes.
